statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-85393 is an improper verification of cryptographic signatures in node-forge. The director image ships node-forge 1.4.0 only as a transitive dependency of the minio client and related crypto-browserify bundles in the sorry-cypress director payload. Scout reports no fixed npm release for 1.4.x. Assessment of reachable signature verification paths and adoption of a patched release are pending.

CVE-2026-85393 is an improper verification of cryptographic signatures in node-forge. The director image ships node-forge 1.4.0 only as a transitive dependency of the minio client and related crypto-browserify bundles in the sorry-cypress director payload. Scout reports no fixed npm release for 1.4.x. Assessment of reachable signature verification paths and adoption of a patched release are pending.

node-forge 1.4.0 is the latest npm release and GitHub Advisories list no patched version for CVE-2026-85393. The component is recorded on the frontend production SPDX SBOM from the build pipeline; the shipped runtime image contains static UI assets only, not a Node.js runtime or node_modules tree. Remediation depends on an upstream node-forge fix and a dependency override once published.
